## Summary

## Contribution type

- [ ] Community or provider Skill implementation
- [ ] New or changed canonical Upgradeable
- [ ] Recipe, bundle, documentation, tooling, or other change

## For Skill implementations

- [ ] I used `templates/SKILL_IMPLEMENTATION_TEMPLATE.md`.
- [ ] I listed target compatibility and selected `slug@version` components.
- [ ] I included activation, failure, output, provenance, and behavioral tests.
- [ ] I ran `python scripts/validate_skill.py <skill-path>`.
- [ ] I did not edit canonical registry metadata solely to add a Skill.

## For canonical Upgradeables

- [ ] I searched for prior art and explained why composition is insufficient.
- [ ] I preserved provenance and did not reuse or invent historical identity.
- [ ] I documented triggers, non-triggers, dependencies, conflicts, and tests.
- [ ] I rebuilt machine-readable artifacts.

## For every repository change

- [ ] I kept the change focused and documented material behavior changes.
- [ ] I ran all applicable validation commands from `README.md`.
